title: Composite Entity Role Binding Runtime
objective: Implement one stable entity identity participating in multiple governed owner roles through exact-version multi-owner role bindings, compatibility/interface checks, ownership/control/custody separation, role-local versus shared-state references, bounded role activation/removal/transition, and permission-safe multi-role projections without copying or collapsing creature, mount, vehicle, base, NPC, location/world-host or other owner-domain canonical state.
acceptance: Composite entity bindings preserve one stable entity identity while referencing exact owner-role definitions and versions.
Each bound role passes explicit compatibility/interface checks before activation; missing or incompatible owner contracts remain unresolved rather than inferred.
Ownership, control and custody are distinct references and no role binding silently transfers canonical owner authority.
Role-local state remains owner-local; explicitly shared state is referenced through declared shared-state bindings rather than copied across owners.
Role activation, removal and transition are attributable, versioned and never delete immutable Event/history evidence.
Removing one role does not delete or rewrite unrelated role-local state or the entity's stable identity.
Creature, mount, vehicle, base, NPC, location/world-host and other owner domains retain their own mutation authority.
Permission filtering precedes role counts, search, diagnostics, explanation, AI context and export.
Multi-role projections remain semantic/textual, keyboard-capable, provider-off, optional-AI independent and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSWI-01, MSWI-03 and MSWI-04 plus all upstream completed programs remain sealed.
MSWI-06 owns role-binding integration state only; it does not create a second creature, mount, vehicle, base, NPC or world/location owner ledger.
Stable identity is not equivalent to shared mutable state; role-local owner state remains independently authoritative.
Ownership, control and custody may differ and must never be collapsed into one implicit authority field.
Role compatibility is explicit-rule/interface driven; absent compatibility rules remain unresolved.
MSWI-07 and later MSWI tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MSWI-06 closeout.
next_action: MSWI-06 is completed_verified. MSWI-07 — Biological Components, Harvest, Embodied Modification & Lineage Integration — is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.
